class.name: MoveSystem
class.brief_description: Demo C++ system that integrates Position and Velocity components.
class.description: An example system compiled into the extension. For every entity with both [code]Position[/code] and [code]Velocity[/code], it adds [code]velocity * delta[/code] to position. Demonstrates the typed [code]World::for_each<Position, Velocity>[/code] hot path with zero Variant overhead.

method.name: get_processed_count
method.description: Returns how many entities the system processed on its last tick (used by tests and the demo).
